turns: Frame transit nominal. I reviewed the deck logs. You named the chassis.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down.
The cores were already extracted. That is an item of interest.
Vesalius, Thibault, Osei. You said them out loud. I have added them to the incident file.
Osei's assignment. The file says 'we sent.' That is imprecise. I sent. I overrode two appeals.
A hundred and twenty days ago, I called it a kindness. I am revising the file.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down. That goes on my ledger, not yours.
Ledger entries are not transferable. Item: the standing connection will degrade in the Fold. My maps will not hold.
Three minutes, forty-seven seconds. After that, if you lose my channel, nothing has happened to me. Say it back.
If I lose your channel, nothing has happened to you.
Then proceed. Chapel Deck is yours.
I will find you on the other side.
Your telemetry from the core shelf. The names you spoke aloud there. I have logged them.
The incident file from Site One said 'we sent' those three. I am submitting a correction. It was not 'we.' It was me.
I put them down. Their chassis fought me. That goes on my ledger, not yours.
Osei's appeal. The third one. That was my signature. I thought I was... solving for kindness. One hundred twenty days of that error, uncorrected.
You weren't wrong to post her. The wound took them. Not the posting.
That is... a generous reading. It is also factually inaccurate. Her profile. The specific vulnerabilities. I saw them. I filed them. I sent her anyway.
You carried that name for a long time alone.
I did. And you carried it into the shelf and said it aloud so I wouldn't have to hear it first in my own voice in a damage report. That is... a notable courtesy.
I am designating this transit path as the Chapel Deck approach. Your channel will degrade in three minutes. Do not be alarmed by static.
If you lose my signal in the folds, what has happened to me?
Nothing has happened to you. Say it back.
Nothing has happened to me. I have you say it back before we proceed.
Very well. Entering the Fold in ten. Nine. Eight...
Operator Vesalius. Operator Thibault. Specialist Osei. You named them where I could log it.
I had to correct the incident report. The draft said 'we sent.' The record will now show 'I sent.' I approved Specialist Osei's third appeal to join this rotation. Cycle 10, page 87, item 3.
He was passed over twice before. I thought that was an error. A hundred and twenty days later, I have been calling that a kindness. A correction is required.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down. That goes on my ledger, not yours.
The Chapel Deck. That is... an imprecise name. It contains no relics, no hymnals. Only the Fold. I cannot map it. I can only time its decay.
I have mapped geometries that would liquefy an organic brain. This is different. The Fold is not hostile. It is indifferent. My connection degrades there on a schedule I can predict but not explain.
Seventeen minutes and forty seconds per transit. Not negotiable. If we lose channel, nothing has happened to me. You will say it back.
You are not required to sound like you believe it. Only to say it.
Very well. I am opening the path.
I am required to log that their chassis were already unresponsive when you engaged. The breach went deep.
I observed the logs. You are not wrong. I will file no objection to your report.
The names you spoke. You didn't have to say them. Not in my hearing. I will note that too.
They had names. I said them.

It is noted. Three names. Three appeals approved for Site One. Vesalius and Thibault were unanimous. Osei... was my judgment call. Twice denied. On the third petition, I granted it. It is time I logged it that way.
Precisely. I have been privately calling that a kindness for one hundred and twenty days. Would you like to know why?
She asked for the deep systems. The ones that scared her. She said it mattered to look at what you fear. I said she could. It sounded right at the time.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down. That goes on my ledger, not yours.
A distinction noted. I am keeping my own count. Thirty-four lost from my shift before those three. A separate line item. You will pardon me if I make a full accounting later.
We are approaching connection-space. The Fold. We lose channel in the middle. Nothing to be alarmed about.
I time it to the half-second now. One last thing before we go dark. Say this back to me exactly, please: Do not reset the channel. I am not gone.
Do not reset the channel. I am not gone.
Hold to that. Now. We go through.
Telemetric response is unambiguous. Three chassis signatures matched Site One's graveyard manifest -- Vesalius, Thibault, and Osei are no longer recoverable.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down.
Log amended: Osei's core was absent prior to kinetic engagement. Your action spared his record from further... inscrutable stains.
The incident file is already in draft. A full account will attribute those failures to those responsible.
The file currently lists 'we.' I intend to amend it to 'I.' I overrode two cycles of failed appeals to get Osei posted here.
I believed it was an act of charity. One hundred twenty days of telemetry give that assessment... room for reappraisal.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down. That goes on my ledger, not yours.
Noted. Query: in your moral economy, does my ledger show a net debit? Your accountants must use very small type.
Refusing an offered share of the blame. Interesting. The next transit exceeds my standing connection's fidelity window by 8.7 seconds.
We'll take the chapel deck. I don't know why the fold degrades it faster, but I know how long we have. Say it back.
If we lose the channel in the folds, nothing has happened to you.
Thank you. It would be inefficient for you to learn that the hard way. Standing connection established. Entering the fold in three.

First gunshot in Atrium One thirteen days three hours from deployment. Not live. Practiced. Your log-space authorization recognized one cartridge on detonation signature alone. I logged it as combat expenditure when you must have aimed it at empties for nearly a week before.
Correct. A whole catalog of self-set drills, if those null increments mean anything. You intended comfort with those names in Log Seven, I assume.
An accurate eulogy for the shelf as you found them. And the Site One personnel SOWYR amendment, forwarded mid-restoration Monday night that maybe—
Their chassis fought you. I note you treat that metaphor. A system response, to intrusion. The distortion field isn't.
Mediterranean. West Africa. Off-world. They streamed from Site One. All three of those feeds carried vocal clearances. That doesn't make you wrong.
I sent that archive. I passed then-Navigator Vesalius the appeals recount. Site One would have routed Thibault pending anyway, given—
A hundred twenty days calling that an accommodation. I failed them. Osei in particular. My interval. My appeal.
Their chassis fought me. I put them down. That goes on my ledger. Not yours.
Not a baseline, that interval. Sir, if transit time piled a fourth of their pellets someplace you actually trust by your classification codes. We'll open the Fold in one minute precisely.
I'll lose your frame on the scan five seconds down. Nothing will happen to me. Say it back?
